user.title: Gree Local
user.description: Keeps your Gree air conditioners off the internet: Home Assistant answers their cloud handshake, so they work only on your local network. Afterwards point *.gree.com to this Home Assistant (AdGuard rule: ||gree.com^$dnsrewrite=HOME_ASSISTANT_IP), block the units' internet access in your router, and restart them.

data.domain_name: Server host name announced to the ACs
data.mqtt_port: MQTT port announced to the ACs

data_description.external_ip: Detected automatically; change it if Home Assistant has another LAN address.
data_description.domain_name: Any *.gree.com name works when *.gree.com is rewritten to this IP.
data_description.mqtt_hold_seconds: 0 closes MQTT attempts immediately (recommended). A higher value slows down the reconnect loop, but some modules (e.g. GRJWB04-J) stop answering locally while they wait.
